task.description: WF-02, step 01c — rework of the design of REQ-105 after the first FAIL of the gate CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (pass 1 of at most 3). Read the remarks N1-N11 in the result of the rework-of handoff and close them in docs/design/REQ-105-e2e-picker.md. Blocking (Medium), each is a fix of a sentence or a row, no redesign: N1 criterion 5 (section 8): the digit-run check on the stored value is red on the correct page because the stored version hash can hold a run of seven digits — name the parts of the value the check covers (the five fields format, version, lang, current, answers; the no-name/phone/mail check goes on the answers and on lang, not on the hash) and prove it on the real page with a sketch; N2 E2S-05 (section 11.1): the system adds the variable __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING to every Node child on macOS — give the test a named allowance and say why (a platform variable, not given by the starter); N3 sub-step 3 (section 14): the edit of E2K-50 lists picker.e2e.js before the file exists — move the entry to the sub-step where the file is made or mark the test expected-red there, and state truthfully which tests are red after each sub-step. Low, close them too or answer each with a reason in section 19 (they are not for the owner): N4 mutant S02 needs a with-child child that ignores SIGTERM so E2S-13 kills it; N5 mutant P21 — add a pass that puts an answer into a hidden question, or say which test catches it; N6 mutant R07 — make E2S-20 use a text with an empty line followed by a line that starts with 'at '; N7 the leftover check pgrep -f 'sai-e2e-' cannot see a leaked stand — define a check that sees stands (by the command line of the stand) and make the sub-step checks and the mutant runs use it; N8 an undefined pid for a bad cwd — state the failure path and its time; N9 mutant Q16 (dark scheme off below 400 px) — decide whether matrix or themes covers it and say where; N10 the 320x568 start-button position is the same in Kazakh as in Russian — say so; N11 the precedence of CLEANUP_FAILED and STAND_EXIT and whether END is on both streams in the noisy mode — state them. Also: the validator saw two picker servers left alive by the sketches of the first pass — clean your sketches by explicit pid when you finish, and never leave a process behind. Do not change what the validator confirmed (O3, O4, the time budget, the replacement table). Sketches outside the project; the task text and the design hold no absolute machine paths and no names of other projects of the owner.
acceptance_criteria: N1, N2, N3 closed and proved by a sketch
N4-N11 closed or answered with a reason

result.summary: Rework of docs/design/REQ-105-e2e-picker.md after the first FAIL of CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR. The three blocking remarks are closed and each is proved on the real system: N1 the digit rule of criterion 5 is applied to lang, current and answers only (not to the 64-hex version hash, which holds the run 3446901 for uchet-pro); N2 E2S-05 has the named allowance __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING (added by macOS to every Node child) and still names the four leak names that must be absent; N3 the SCANNED entry of picker.e2e.js moves to sub-step 4a (with the file) and the sub-step table states the red tests after each sub-step, measured in four states. The Low remarks N4-N11 are closed in the design (N4 child of with-child ignores SIGTERM, N5 sixth pass 'hidden' plus mutants P21/P24, N6 negative text of E2S-20, N7 leftover check LEFT by the program that was started, N8 no pid -> thrown at once, N9 matrix colours per scheme plus mutant P25, N10 'Russian and Kazakh', N11 CLEANUP_FAILED wins and END on both streams); table 19.1 of the design lists how each is closed. What the validator confirmed (O3, O4, the time budget, the replacement table) is unchanged except the one moved edit of N3. No process left behind.

issues.text: Clean-up of the first pass: the two picker servers the validator saw (pids 17526 and 17610) are no longer alive at the start of this rework (ps showed none). Eight old 'node -e setInterval(() => {}, 1000)' processes (started 2026-11-03 21:12-21:25, parent pid 1) are not from the sketches of this run and were left; ORCH decides about them.

N11: the precedence CLEANUP_FAILED over STAND_EXIT cannot be forced with a real process (nothing survives SIGKILL of its group), so no E2S test can catch its reversal; the design says REVIEWER reads it in stand.js against 4.1 (section 19.1). If the validator wants a test, the way is an injected group-signal dependency in deps, which is a design change not made here.

Equivalent mutant named in section 16: bodyAnswers returning the raw answers while setAnswer still prunes cannot be told by any page test; the single-place mutant is P24, the both-places mutant is P21. Q01 of the gate is therefore P21 as now defined.
Q15 of the gate (English lost-net text) survives and stays informational: English is outside criterion 8. Not a mutant of this design.

Not run: the final picker.e2e.js and the final starter do not exist yet; the new assertions (hidden pass, colours per scheme, value fields) were proven by sketches on the real page, not by the final spec. The time budget gets one more pass (about 0.3-0.5 s) and stays far under the limit; the line of 48000 ms of section 7 is unchanged.
